q: What year did The Goonies come out in theaters?
explain: 1985, the same year as Back to the Future!

q: How many kids are in the Goonies gang?
explain: Seven: Mikey, Brand, Chunk, Mouth, Data, Andy and Stef. It is on your fact sheet under By the numbers.

q: Who has to do the Truffle Shuffle before the others will let him in?
explain: Chunk. It is the very first thing we see him do, and the Goonies never let him forget it.

q: Put the treasure hunt in order.
items: Mikey finds the map in the attic
Chunk is captured by the Fratellis
The Goonies find One-Eyed Willy's ship
The ship sails out of the cave on its own
explain: Map first, then Chunk gets caught, then the ship, and at the very end it sails away by itself.

q: Sloth is part of the Fratelli family.
explain: True. Sloth is the Fratelli brother they keep chained in the basement, and he chooses the Goonies instead.
Die! Mikey shouts it when everyone wants to give up and go home.

q: Why do the Goonies need a miracle to save their homes?
options: The country club plans to buy the neighborhood and bulldoze it
A storm washed away the docks
The school is expanding onto their street
explain: The Goondocks is about to become a golf course unless the families can pay off the bank.

q: Which pirate left the treasure behind?
explain: One-Eyed Willy, the first Goonie. He hid his ship and treasure from the British navy.

q: How is the Goondocks finally saved at the end?
options: Jewels hidden in Mikey's marble bag pay off the debt
They sell One-Eyed Willy's ship to a museum
The Fratellis' reward money covers it
explain: Mikey skipped the scale on Willy's treasure... but his marble bag caught a handful of jewels. No pen! Do not sign!
That is Chunk on the left, played by Jeff Cohen. The other three are Mikey, Mouth and Data.
